company.shortDescription: Powerful workflow automation with the simplicity of a spreadsheet.
company.description:
Decisional helps fast moving operations teams in RevOps, GTM Ops and Finance Ops build powerful Agents that automate spreadsheet work.
You configure Agents with natural language and connect them to apps and tools that help you get long running background work done.
